NHAI launches local pass service for residents near toll plazas

The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has introduced a new service allowing residents living within a 20-kilometer radius of toll plazas to purchase local passes. This initiative is accessible through the Rajmargyatra App. The service aims to provide benefits to local communities situated near these highway infrastructure points.
